situation: A firm whose file and email servers reach end of support next year.
complication: The servers must be replaced or retired, and the firm had outages last year.
key_question: Should the firm replace its servers or move to a cloud office suite?

titles.situation: The firm's servers reach end of support next year.
titles.options: Two ways to replace the servers.
titles.recommendation: Move to the cloud suite if the managing partner agrees.
titles.roadmap: Decide, plan the migration, then retire the servers.
titles.kpis: Two measures show the move worked.
titles.risks: The main risk is a disruptive migration.

figures.label: Cloud suite price per user per month

issue_tree.finding: The two options cost about the same over the period.
issue_tree.so_what: Cost does not decide this; risk and fit do.

chart.title: Total cost over the period against budget.

issue_tree.finding: The cloud ends hand patching, which may be behind the outages.
points: The firm's two IT staff patch the servers by hand.
The firm had [F10] outages last year.

hypotheses.text: The outages came from missed patches.
Staff need to work from any office.

issue_tree.so_what: The cloud ends hand patching; whether that cuts outages is untested.

options.name: Cloud suite
options.description: Move files and email to a cloud office suite and retire the servers.

options.name: Replace servers
options.description: Buy new servers with support and keep running them in-house.

recommendation.rationale: It costs about [F8] less, stays within budget and frees the IT staff from hand patching; the managing partner decides.

actions: Give the managing partner the recommendation within the six weeks.
If the managing partner chooses the cloud, agree the migration plan with the provider.
Once the move is approved, move email first, then shared files, office by office.
Retire the servers once files are moved and checked.

kpis.name: Staff able to work from any office

risks.mitigation: Move one office at a time and keep the servers until each is checked.
Agree a fixed price for the comparison period.
